mapper.select: select dur.dates, dur.pkg, dur.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name config_group_name, count(DISTINCT dul.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_register dur INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = dur.user_id) where dur.dates = #{dates} group by dur.dates, dur.pkg, dur.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name
